# SLA Timer Badge

## Summary
Draws one SLA timer as a hue-coded chip with an optional proportional bar: remaining time, urgency colour, paused and breached states. Live only where hydrated; prerendered slots pass `@live={{false}}` and show the stored snapshot.

## API
Args: `facts?: TimerFacts` (an SLA Timer field model works directly), `caption?`, `live?`, `bar?`. Ticks off the shared `slaClock` so a queue of badges costs one interval.

## Usage
```ts
import { SlaTimerBadge } from '@cardstack/catalog/cards/service-desk/components/sla-timer-badge';

<SlaTimerBadge @facts={{@model.resolutionTimer}} @caption='Resolution' @live={{true}} />
```

## Non-goals
No SLA arithmetic of its own: deadlines come stored on the timer, the countdown comes from `utils/sla`.
